title: Argentina vs France: Breaking Down the Greatest Final
description:
The 2022 World Cup final ended 3-3 before Argentina won on penalties. StatsBomb's event data shows Argentina with 10 shots to France's 2 before the 79th minute, then France scoring twice in two minutes. Argentina built the lead; France built the comeback. Shots, passing networks and expected goals are computed from recorded events, not tracking data.
